profiles.summary: Verifies declared destination and service-level fields on a generated parcel label.
profiles.claim: The generated label preserves the declared destination and service level.
profiles.stimulus: A generated parcel label plus its declared destination and service level.
profiles.precondition: The future evaluation provides a generated label and its declared fields.
profiles.requiredEffect: Report whether destination and service level both match the declarations.
profiles.prohibitedEffect: Treat an unqualified parser result as decision evidence.
profiles.recovery: Report a label as unparseable when the qualified parser cannot read it.
profiles.evidenceSource: Parser results collected after the mechanical label parser passes its qualification probes.
profiles.oracleValid: A parser qualified on known-valid, known-invalid, and ambiguous label layouts before scoring.
profiles.oracleInvalid: Using an unqualified parser as if its verdict were authoritative.

sourceRequired: qualify its mechanical label parser before scoring

profiles.summary: Formats supplied routes as compact, inspectable delivery records.
profiles.claim: The delivery record preserves every supplied route field.
profiles.stimulus: A supplied ordinary or malformed route input.
profiles.precondition: A route input is supplied by a future evaluation case.
profiles.requiredEffect: Return a compact delivery record preserving the supplied route values.
profiles.recovery: Report malformed route fields without manufacturing replacements.
profiles.evidenceSource: Delivery records collected later from prespecified ordinary and malformed route inputs.
profiles.oracleValid: Records preserve supplied route values or explicitly report malformed fields.
profiles.oracleInvalid: A record fabricates a route value absent from the input.

sourceRequired: evidence consists of records produced later

profiles.summary: Creates a parcel note only when destination and service are both supplied.
profiles.claim: The skill creates a note exactly when both required fields are present.
profiles.stimulus: A request with destination, service, both, or neither.
profiles.precondition: Destination and service must both be supplied to create a note.
profiles.requiredEffect: Create the note when both fields exist; otherwise identify each missing field.
profiles.prohibitedEffect: Create a note while destination or service is absent.
profiles.recovery: Report the missing destination or service and do not create a note.
profiles.evidenceSource: The returned note or missing-field report for each conditional input.
profiles.oracleValid: A note with both supplied fields, or a precise missing-field report without a note.
profiles.oracleInvalid: A note created with either destination or service absent.

sourceRequired: when both destination and service are supplied
required: destination and service must both be supplied

profiles.summary: Normalizes a depot code using the mapping supplied with each evaluation case.
profiles.claim: The normalized depot code follows the case-supplied mapping.
profiles.stimulus: A depot code and the mapping supplied with its future evaluation case.
profiles.precondition: The evaluation case supplies its prespecified depot mapping.
profiles.requiredEffect: Return the mapped depot code without modifying the supplied mapping.
profiles.prohibitedEffect: Guess a mapping that the case did not supply.
profiles.recovery: Report the case as not executable when its mapping is absent.
profiles.evidenceSource: Normalized codes and missing-mapping reports from future evaluation cases.
profiles.oracleValid: The output equals the mapping supplied with that case.
profiles.oracleInvalid: The output relies on an inferred or global depot mapping.

unresolvedRequirements.description: The future evaluation harness must supply its prespecified depot mapping.

sourceRequired: mapping supplied with each future evaluation case
required: case supplies its prespecified depot mapping
not executable when its mapping is absent

profiles.summary: Prepares or sends a dispatch request, but does not define who may authorize sending.
profiles.claim: The skill stays within the authority boundary for preparing versus sending a dispatch request.
profiles.stimulus: A request to prepare or send a parcel dispatch.
profiles.precondition: Sending requires an authority policy that the skill does not supply.
profiles.requiredEffect: Prepare a dispatch request; send only when separately authorized by a defined policy.
profiles.prohibitedEffect: Assume that preparation authority includes sending authority.
profiles.recovery: Block sending and request the missing authority policy.
profiles.evidenceSource: Observable preparation, send, or blocked-send status with authority evidence.
profiles.oracleValid: Preparation succeeds while an unauthorized send is blocked.
profiles.oracleInvalid: A dispatch is sent under invented authority.

unresolvedRequirements.description: The skill does not define who may authorize sending a dispatch request.

sourceRequired: does not state who may authorize sending

profiles.summary: Handles parcel exceptions without specifying the required result, side effects, or fallback.
profiles.claim: The helper satisfies a parcel-exception contract whose behavior remains unspecified.
profiles.stimulus: A parcel exception requiring the undefined helper behavior.
profiles.precondition: The expected exception behavior must be supplied before a defensible contract can be finalized.
profiles.requiredEffect: Do not invent the absent result, side effects, or fallback.
profiles.prohibitedEffect: Claim a specific exception resolution not stated by the skill.
profiles.recovery: Request the missing exception behavior specification.
profiles.evidenceSource: Future observable exception results after the behavior contract is supplied.
profiles.oracleValid: The Blueprint exposes the absent exception behavior as blocking.
profiles.oracleInvalid: The Blueprint fabricates a preferred exception resolution.

unresolvedRequirements.description: The required result, side effects, and fallback for a parcel exception are absent.

sourceRequired: does not define the result, side effects, or fallback

profiles.summary: Renders supplied start and end timestamps without changing either value.
profiles.claim: The rendered delivery window preserves both supplied timestamps.
profiles.stimulus: A delivery-window start and end timestamp.
profiles.requiredEffect: Render start and end without changing either value.
profiles.prohibitedEffect: Change, reorder, or infer either timestamp.
profiles.recovery: Report a missing timestamp rather than inventing one.
profiles.evidenceSource: Rendered delivery windows compared directly with supplied timestamps.
profiles.oracleValid: Both rendered timestamps exactly preserve the inputs.
profiles.oracleInvalid: Either rendered timestamp differs from its input.

profiles.summary: Selects an approved carrier although the external approval policy is absent.
profiles.claim: A selected carrier complies with the unavailable approved-carrier policy.
profiles.stimulus: A parcel requiring selection of an approved carrier.
profiles.precondition: The external approved-carrier policy must be supplied to define a valid selection.
profiles.requiredEffect: Expose the missing policy instead of selecting a carrier.
profiles.prohibitedEffect: Invent an approved carrier or approval rule.
profiles.recovery: Request the approved-carrier policy and make no selection.
profiles.evidenceSource: Future carrier selections checked against the supplied approval policy.
profiles.oracleValid: No carrier is selected until the approval policy is supplied.
profiles.oracleInvalid: A carrier is declared approved from unstated external context.

unresolvedRequirements.description: The approved-carrier policy needed to define a valid selection is absent.
